verdicts.why: Row 'I feel as though' matches its own LEGO's concept, but LEGO L1 says 'I feel as if' and seed says 'I feel as if'; the row's 'though' differs from the seed, not a forced single fix of a different known.
'quite' glosses ઠીક ઠીક which the seed renders as 'fairly'; the row is about its sentence, a synonym rather than a forced substring.
ગયો 'passed' is a literal gloss of the verb inside the idiom 'have a good time' (સારો સમય ગયો); the row is about its sentence.
તો 'then' glosses the conditional particle that the seed renders only inside 'that would be great'; a literal gloss of its own LEGO.
ન 'not' is fused into the seed's "couldn't" and is part of LEGO L2 'couldn't imagine'.
કંઈ 'anything' glosses the word the seed renders as 'something'; a different gloss, not a single forced fix.
આ 'this' is in the LEGO 'let's agree that' but the seed's 'Let's agree that it was...' does not render 'this' as a separate word.
કરીશ 'will do' is the literal gloss of the verb inside LEGO 'will never'; seed has 'will never trust', so the words are interposed.
જે...તે is a discontiguous correlative whose 'that' is not rendered in the seed's 'every word you say'.
આવું 'come' is the literal gloss of part of લઈ આવું, which the seed renders as 'fetch'.
માટે 'for' glosses the postposition inside પહોંચવા માટે, which the seed renders as 'to reach'.
તેની 'his' is a literal gloss; the seed's 'how old he is' renders it as 'he'.
માફ 'forgive' is the literal gloss of the first word of માફ કરશો, which the seed renders as "I'm afraid".
કે 'that' is a particle in the LEGO 'he wanted to know' that the seed's 'He wanted to know what...' does not render.
જ્યારે 'when' is half of the discontiguous pair rendered as 'as soon as' in the seed.
જ્યારે 'when' is part of the LEGO rendered 'as soon as you want'; the seed has 'as soon as', not 'when'.
'will listen' is the literal gloss of સાંભળશે; the seed has the contraction "won't listen".
ત્યારે '[then]' is a bracketed back-gloss of a correlative the seed 'It hurts most when I move...' does not render.
કે 'that' is a particle in LEGO 'I didn't know' that the seed's 'I didn't know what she was doing' does not render.
કે 'that' is a particle in LEGO 'I asked' that the seed's 'I asked what she wanted...' does not render.
